   106→    action: str                     # CommandType value ("create_node", "set_parm", etc.)
   107→    description: str                # Human-readable

   253→    success: Optional[bool] = None

   263→        return [s for s in self.steps if s.status == StepStatus.PENDING]

   267→        return [s for s in self.steps if s.status == StepStatus.COMPLETED]

   269→    def failed_steps(self) -> List[AgentStep]:
